business_summary: Human Health Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides healthcare services in Hong Kong. The company offers general practice services, including general consultation, diagnostics and preventative health, minor procedure, vaccination, physical check-up, health education, occupational health advisory, Chinese medicine, work injury assessment, telemedicine, COVID-19 related, outreach services, and healthcare related services and products. It also provides specialty services in the areas of general surgery, orthopedics and traumatology, ophthalmology, otorhinolaryngology, pediatrics, obstetrics and gynecology, gastroenterology and hepatology, cardiology, pediatric surgery, dermatology and venereology, psychiatry, radiology, urology, nephrology, neurosurgery, anaesthesiology, and oncology, as well as physiotherapy, medical aesthetics, nutritionist, health and wellness, endoscopy, and medical diagnostics. In addition, the company offers dental services comprising general dentistry, dental implant, root canal therapy, microscopic endodontics, crown and bridge, oral surgery, root planing, orthodontic treatment, 3D guided implant and surgery, and intraoral scanning, intraoral digital impression, CAD/CAM dentistry, laser dentistry, cone-beam computed tomography, cephalometric imaging, panoramic radiography, filling and extraction, and dental scaling, cosmetics dentistry, specialist dentistry, and other dental services. Further, it provides medical imaging services, engages in property investment, and management of consultancy agreements with doctors and dentists. The company operates through service points comprising general practice service points, specialties service points, and dental service points. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong. Human Health Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Treasure Group Global Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Human Health Holdings Limited는 홍콩에서 의료 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 일반 상담, 진단 및 예방 건강, 경미한 시술, 예방 접종, 신체 검진, 건강 교육, 직업 건강 자문, 한의학, 산업 재해 평가, 원격 의료, 코로나19 관련, 지원 서비스, 의료 관련 서비스 및 제품을 포함한 일반 의료 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 일반외과, 정형외과 및 외상학, 안과, 이비인후과, 소아과, 산부인과, 위장병학 및 간장학, 심장학, 소아외과, 피부과 및 성병학, 정신의학, 방사선과, 비뇨기과, 신장학, 신경외과, 마취과, 종양학, 물리치료, 의료 분야의 전문 서비스를 제공합니다. 미학, 영양사, 건강 및 복지, 내시경, 의료 진단. 또한 이 회사는 일반 치과, 치과 임플란트, 근관 치료, 미세 근관 치료, 크라운 및 브릿지, 구강 수술, 치근 활주술, 교정 치료, 3D 가이드 임플란트 및 수술, 구강 스캐닝, 구강 내 스캔으로 구성된 치과 서비스를 제공합니다.
